ns2:course.label: Literature Seminar in Math
ns2:course.description: Seminar on topics of current interest in mathematics. Students present seminars and discussions on various topics. See Class Schedule for current topics. Recommended for all Mathematics students. 0 to 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in the same or separate semesters as topics vary. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
